rounds.title: Stat-tile baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK stat tile (et-stat-tile with a projected et-stat-tile-sparkline), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design inside an outlined et-card on the page, as its stories show it: a 14px muted label, a 28px value at weight 600 (optional unit at 0.6em, muted), a 13px footer with the signed delta (weight 600, a triangle or bar icon in the text colour) and a muted caption, and a 32px sparkline (2px line in the subtle surface text, the last value an 8px dot in the primary colour). States: default (up, good, with sparkline), up-bad (danger), down-good, down-unrated (goodDirection null, muted), unchanged, unit, no-value (dash), without-sparkline, loading (skeleton, sparkline hidden). The tile is not interactive: no hover, active or focus ring, so Q88 and Q101 do not arise. A good delta reads the success theme; the sdk product registers none, so the mock keeps the brand theme around it (the real component throws on a good delta without a registered success theme: injectSemanticThemes reads it). Fixed numbers, all passing (light / dark, against the card): value 17.93 / 17.18; label, caption, unit and a neutral delta (muted) 7.81 / 6.94; good delta text and icon (brand ink) 5.48 / 13.50; bad delta (danger ink) 6.47 / 6.48; sparkline line (subtle) 4.95 / 4.99. Today on light the current dot is mint, 1.33:1 against the card (dark 13.50:1). Q98 numbers only: the outlined card fill equals the page (1.00:1 both), its 1px edge 1.26:1 light, 1.73:1 dark. Variant b applies decided Q99 rule a only: the mint dot becomes ink. b adds no edge, so Q102 does not arise and there is no c.

a.note: Today: the sparkline's current dot is the bare mint primary, 1.33:1 against the light card, under 3:1 (dark 13.50:1). Everything else as in the round note.

b.note: Pick. Decided Q99 rule a, not a new call: the sparkline's current dot in --et-theme-color-ink-solid, 5.48:1 against the light card; dark ink is the mint, 13.50:1, so dark is unchanged. No fill, so no inset edge and no Q102.
